tr: Where's your house? / My house is near Hoan Kiem Lake.
Do you eat fresh herbs? / Yes, I really like herbs.
The weather's so nice today! / It sure is, let's go out.
Are you busy today? / Yes, I'm really busy today.
What would you like? / A kilo of oranges, please.
Do you want some milk? / Yes, please.
Who's Minh? / Minh is my friend.
Hello! I'm Emma. / Hello, Emma! I'm Minh.
Hi, Hùng! How are you? / I'm fine, thanks. And you?
Sorry I'm late. / No problem.
Thanks a lot! / You're welcome.
This is my friend Thảo. / Hi, Thảo, nice to meet you.
Do you have any brothers or sisters? / Yes, I have an older brother and a younger sister.
Where do your parents live? / My parents live in Da Nang.
This is my mother. / Hello. (politely, to a friend's mother)
What's your name? / My name is Linh. (an older woman and a young girl)
How much is this bowl of pho? / Fifty thousand dong.
How many people are in the Vietnamese class? / There are twenty-five.
I'll be there in ten minutes, OK? / Sure, I'll wait for you.
Whose cat is that? / It's Lan's.
What's this? / It's a conical hat.
Is this book good? / It's really good, you should read it.
What will you have? / A bowl of beef pho, please.
What would you like to drink? / An iced tea, please.
Check, please! / Sure, that's one hundred twenty thousand in all.
Do you eat beef? / No, I'm vegetarian.
Excuse me, how much is it? / Thirty thousand.
Two hundred thousand is too expensive. Can you take a little off? / All right, one hundred eighty thousand.
Can I help you? / I'm just looking, thanks.
This shirt is a little tight. Do you have a bigger size? / Yes, just a moment.
What time is it now? / It's already half past three.
What day is it today? / Today is Friday.
Are you free tomorrow? / I'm free tomorrow. What's up?
Excuse me, where is the restroom? / It's on the second floor.
Excuse me, where's the bank? / Go straight, then turn right at the intersection.
Excuse me, how far is Hoan Kiem Lake from here? / Only about a kilometer.
How long does it take on foot? / About fifteen minutes.
Is there a café near here? / Yes, next to the post office.
Excuse me, I'm lost. What street is this? / This is Hang Bac Street.
Shall we take a motorbike taxi? / No, let's take a taxi, it's raining.
Let me off here, please. / OK. That's thirty thousand.
Hello, where are you going? / Take me to Noi Bai Airport.
Excuse me, what time does the train leave? / The train leaves at seven p.m.
One ticket to Hue, please. / One-way or round-trip?
Hi, I have a reservation. My name is Jack. / Sure, may I see your passport?
Why aren't we boarding yet? / The flight is delayed an hour.
Where do you work? / I work at a bank.
Can you swim? / Yes, I can.
Your Vietnamese is really good! / Thanks, but I'm not that good yet.
Are you free? / Sorry, I'm in a meeting.
Excuse me, I have a question. / Sure, go ahead.
How can I help you? / I'd like to open an account.
Why didn't you go to work today? / I'm sick.
Is there a pharmacy near here? / Yes, at the end of the street.
What's wrong? / I have a bad headache.
Do you have cold medicine? / Yes. Take it three times a day.
Are you OK? / I'm fine, thank you.
Excuse me, I lost my wallet. / Go to the police station at the end of the street.
What's your name? / My name is Jack. And you?
Where are you from? / I'm American.
Where's your hometown? / My hometown is Hue.
What do you do? / I'm an engineer. And you?
You speak Vietnamese? / Just a little. I'm Vietnamese American.
How long have you been in Vietnam? / I've been in Vietnam for three weeks.
What do you think of this shirt? / This shirt is very pretty.
Which is colder, Hanoi or Saigon? / Hanoi is colder than Saigon.
Where should we eat? / Let's go to this place. The pho here is really good.
Is this dish spicy? / This dish isn't spicy at all.
Vietnamese is so hard! / It's not that hard!
Who is he? / That's Minh, Lan's friend.
How do you like Hanoi? / I think it's beautiful, but so crowded.
Are you busy? / No, I'm not. What's up?
Have you been to Hue yet? / Not yet, but I'm going next month.
What will you have? Coffee or tea? / Tea, please.
Can I take photos here? / Of course.
I like beef pho. / Me too.
What's up? Going home? / Yeah, I'm tired.
You're a teacher, right? / No, I'm not a teacher. I'm a nurse.
Where's Hanoi Station? / It's on Le Duan Street.
Hi there! Have you eaten? / Yes, I have.
Where are you off to? / I'm going to the market.
How are you? / I'm well, thank you.
Excuse me! Can I have the menu? / Yes, here you are.
Dear! / Yes, Grandma, did you call me?
Come at eight tomorrow, OK? / Yes, I will.
Would you like some more? / No, thank you. I'm full.
Can you come help me tomorrow? / Yes, that's fine.
Hi, is Lan home? / Yes. Please come in.
Excuse me, where's the bus stop? / It's across the street.
Hello, Grandma. / Hello, dear. Come on in.
Have some more. / Thank you, you're such a good cook!
Have some more! / I'm full, it was delicious.
I've fixed your motorbike. / You're really good at this!
Shall we go to Ha Long this weekend? / That's a great idea!
I'm forty this year. / Really? You look so young!
Please come in. / Your home is so beautiful!
Your child is so well-behaved! / Thanks, at home he's very naughty.
You speak Vietnamese like a native! / Not at all, I still have a lot to learn.
You take beautiful photos! / You flatter me.
This dish you made is so good! / It's nothing special, go ahead and eat.
You sing beautifully! / You're making me blush.
You're so pretty! / Really? Thank you.
Sorry I'm late. / That's OK. You look beautiful tonight.
How do I look in this shirt? / You look so handsome!
Why are you looking at me like that? / Because you have such a pretty smile.
Your eyes are so beautiful. / You're making me blush.
You have such a lovely voice. Sing one more song! / Oh no, I'm too shy.
You're just my type. / How many people have you said that to?
You always make me laugh. / That's because you laugh easily.
Let me get the door for you. / You're such a gentleman.
Do you have a boyfriend? / Not yet. And you?
Can I have your number? / Sure, here's my number.
Shall we go for coffee this afternoon? / Sure, I'd love to.
Are you free this weekend? / I'm free on Sunday. What's up?
Tonight was really fun. I'd like to see you again. / Me too.
Hello, it's me. / I miss you. See you tomorrow?
I like you. / Really? I like you too.
Your cooking is better than a restaurant's. / You're such a flatterer!
Will you be my girlfriend? / Let me think about it.
Could I have your number? / Thanks, but I'm seeing someone.
I've liked you for a long time. / Sorry, I only see you as a friend. Let's stay friends.
Have dinner with me tonight? / Thanks, but I can't go.
This is a present for you. / Oh, it's so pretty! Thank you.
Minh is from Hue, you know. / Oh, really?
Ah, Minh! Where are you off to? / I'm going to the market.
Ow! That's hot! / Careful, the coffee is still hot.
Ouch, that hurts! / Are you OK?
Oh my God, it's pouring! / Let's wait a bit and then go.
Oh my goodness, you're home! / Hi, Mom!
Oh no, I forgot my wallet! / It's fine, I'll pay.
Huh, where did Minh go? / He just went home.
Let's go to Ha Long tomorrow. / What? Tomorrow?
Hey, Nam! Where are you going? / I'm going to class.
Pho or bun cha? / Hmm… bun cha.
Do you know this place? / Er… I don't remember.
Shh! The baby is sleeping. / Sorry.
This is balut. / Eww! I'm not eating that.
It's thirty-nine degrees today. / Yikes, that's hot!
This is my new motorbike. / Wow, it's beautiful!
That motorbike nearly hit me! / Phew, that was close! Are you OK?
There are two tickets left. / Lucky! Two tickets, please.
I'm busy tonight. / What a pity! Another time, then.
Vietnam won! / Hooray!
My exam is tomorrow, I'm so scared. / You can do it! You're a good student.
Watch out! There's a motorbike! / Thanks.
I got into college! / Congratulations!
Hello, who's this? / It's Minh. Are you free?
